items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: our next frontier model
items.summary: Google launched Gemini 4 Carbon, calling it its strongest model yet with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long-horizon agentic capabilities.
items.imageAlt: Google's official Gemini 4 Carbon launch graphic

items.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
items.summary: Mistral open-weighted Le Chonk, a 1T-parameter multimodal model it calls the best open-weight coder, stressing cyber-patch work and refusals of malicious requests.
items.imageAlt: Photo of Mistral AI co-founder and CEO Arthur Mensch

items.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
items.summary: Nvidia released a free speech-to-text model covering up to 40 languages, limited to recorded audio, aimed at meeting and medical transcription rather than live use.
items.imageAlt: Illustration of a mouth for TechCrunch's voice AI story

items.title: Apple acquires Ascend.io, an agentic AI engineering startup
items.summary: Apple acquired Ascend.io, an agentic data-engineering startup, disclosed under the EU's Digital Markets Act; Ascend.io is winding down operations.
items.imageAlt: Screenshot of the Ascend.io website from 9to5Mac's report

items.title: DoorDash said it's only received 'several hundred' orders from AI agents
items.summary: DoorDash said AI agents have placed only several hundred orders so far, and that it is open to working with third-party agent makers on integration.
